cues.text: Good morning, listeners! And welcome back to Star Radio!
cues.speaker: PRESENTER

cues.text: Today on the show we have a visitor from Yazoo Car Rental who is going to give us an insight into his company and into the public transport system!
cues.speaker: PRESENTER

cues.text: Welcome Jonathan!
cues.speaker: PRESENTER

cues.text: Thank you for having me.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: Yes, I would like to start by introducing my company Yazoo Car Rental.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: We are the cheapest and most reliable rental company in the city and have won multiple awards for the quality of our services.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: This success did not come easily, however, and it proved important that we stay fresh and are always thinking of ways to attract new customers.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: Our first attempt to do this was to offer a free gift with every car rental, which we were confident the customers would be very interested in.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: The offer of a free hoover with each rental, however, did not attract any new customers so we quite quickly stopped offering it.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: In 2002, a new taxi company opened next door to us and we started losing a lot of business to them, so we introduced an offer that we hoped might compete with their service.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: We offered a new package where you could rent a car with a driver for a small extra fee.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: By introducing this offer, we found that all of our customers preferred to drive the cars themselves, so again this offer was unsuccessful in attracting more customers.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: Learning from these mistakes, we decided to offer a package service where the customer no longer had to come to our offices to pick up the rental car.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: Instead we could drop off and pick up the car anywhere in the city to make the customer’s experience a lot more stress free.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: This offer was very popular and increased our profits by 30%.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: In order to attract a younger demographic, we updated the models of cars that we offered for rental.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: We began offering more trendy cars such as minis and smart cars that we thought might appeal to the younger crowd and we also purchased them in more fun colours like reds and greens.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: This offer attracted some new customers of a younger age group, however not as many as we hoped.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: Next I decided to offer our services at a discounted price on our website where it could be seen by thousands of people.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: I thought that this could be a great way to attract a number of new customers who would never have heard of us before and it worked fantastically well.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: Following the success of the discount offer, we had so many customers that it became necessary to open a new branch of the company in the centre of the city.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: The cost of renting offices in the city centre was very high, so we hoped that our profits would justify this expensive decision.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: We made enough profit to keep our city centre offices open, but we had hoped for a greater increase in customer numbers.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: Now for the second part of my talk, which is on the topic of public transport.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: There are many benefits to public transport, for example, the recent introduction of bus lanes has meant that buses are now unaffected by traffic jams and are able to stay on schedule.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: Unfortunately, as fewer and fewer people are taking the bus nowadays, the service has become quite inefficient.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: This reduction in passengers may be due to the stories in the newspaper about the dangers posed to pedestrian safety by the buses, however this is largely untrue as buses are responsible for far less pedestrian-related accidents than cars.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: I use the bus service often, as car petrol is so expensive nowadays that the bus is far more affordable.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: However, if I am in a rush I prefer to take a taxi as they tend to get you to your destination very quickly so you can remain punctual for your appointments.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: I also very much enjoy flying to my destinations, as the service is incredibly fast and the airports are always very easy to find.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: Personally, my favourite mode of transportation is the bus.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: Due to the lack of people using the service I have found that the buses are never overcrowded so there is always a seat available.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: They are also never dirty as they get cleaned regularly.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: However, I have found that sometimes the bus can be over a half hour behind schedule which can be very frustrating.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: There has been a lot of fluctuation in the price of bus tickets in the last couple of years.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: In the past, £1.80 for a ticket was enough to sustain the bus companies, however, as the price of fuel increased so did the ticket prices.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: Now the ticket prices are declining as the bus companies try to encourage more people to use their service again.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN

cues.text: Well, that’s all from me today. Thank you for listening.
cues.speaker: JONATHAN
